headline: 9 global labour groups urge Bangladesh to set RMG minimum wage at living level
summary: Nine global labour groups have urged Bangladesh to set the garment sector minimum wage at a living wage level. They also urged brands to absorb any wage increase rather than shift orders.
why: Ready-made garments are Bangladesh's dominant export industry, so wage decisions affect factory costs and global apparel sourcing. Brands' sourcing choices shape order flows to the country.
